service.description: Internal: the records a message links to, for its record cards: each /qapps link in its body whose query names a record id (workEffortId, requestId, partyId, orderId, invoiceId, paymentId, shipmentId, productId, facilityId, assetId, communicationEventId), up to five, as [{entity, id}]. The card checks, for each reader, that the reader may see the record.

A task, request or event made from a chat message (the message actions, design §13 MessageActions): mantle.party.CommunicationServices.create#RecordFromChatMessage names it from the message's first line, files the message on it as a communication event, and in a record room links it to that record; it checks that the user may read the room (a message removed, or of a room the user may not read, is "not found"). Out: the new record, its Commons link (url, null when Commons has no screen for it) and a message for the user.

actions.script: if (!['task', 'request', 'event'].includes(kind)) { ec.message.addError(`Create a task, request or event, not ${kind}`); return } const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.CommunicationServices.create#RecordFromChatMessage').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId, eventSeq: eventSeq, recordKind: kind}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return recordEntityName = out.recordEntityName recordId = out.recordId roomRecordLinked = !!out.roomRecordLinked const link = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.commons.PaletteServices.get#RecordLink').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntityName, id: recordId}).call() url = link && link.url ? link.url : null message = ec.resource.expand({task: 'Task ${id} made from the message', request: 'Request ${id} made from the message', event: 'Event ${id} made from the message'}[kind], '', {id: recordId}) + (roomRecordLinked ? ' ' + ec.l10n.localize('and linked to the room\'s record') : '')

service.description: File a chat message on a record (the message actions' File on a record): the message as a communication event (mantle.party.CommunicationServices.findOrCreate#ChatCommunicationEvent, which checks that the user may read the room) linked to the record (link#CommunicationEventRecord, which checks that the user may see the record), so the record's Chatter shows it. Out: the record's title and Commons link.

actions.script: const info = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.get#RecordInfo').parameters({recordEntityName: recordEntityName, recordId: recordId, requireVisible: true}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return const found = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.CommunicationServices.findOrCreate#ChatCommunicationEvent').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId, eventSeq: eventSeq}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return communicationEventId = found.communicationEventId ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.CommunicationServices.link#CommunicationEventRecord').parameters({communicationEventId: communicationEventId, recordEntityName: info.info.recordEntityName, recordId: recordId, recordUrl: info.url || null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return title = [info.typeLabel, info.title].filter((part) => part).join(' ') url = info.url || null
